newsitem.title: USA: Consumers 67 MW nuke seen back next week.
newsitem.headline: Consumers 67 MW nuke seen back next week.

text.p: Consumers Power Co's 67 megawatt Big Rock Point nuclear power plant will likely resume production early next week after having to drop an initial restart attempt, a company spokesman said Friday.
The plant, in Charlevoix, Mich., was shut Friday due to a turbine vibration.
"We're looking at early next week for a restart," said spokesman Tim Petrosky.

Big Rock Point had been operating at 20 percent of capacity as of early Thursday but had not yet synchronized to the grid, rebuilding power from an outage which began last weekend to repair an unstable main generator field current.
Consumers Power Co is a subsidiary of CMS Energy Corp.
